title: Ohio Maritime Assistance Program (MAP)
summary: Competitive program supporting maritime cargo terminal planning and infrastructure improvements on Lake Erie and Ohio River facilities.
notes: Port of Cleveland recently received awards through this program.

title: Ohio Public Works Commission State Capital Improvement Program
summary: Funds public infrastructure improvements including roads utilities and transportation assets tied to economic development corridors.
notes: Could support port-adjacent roadway and utility upgrades.

title: Clean Ohio Revitalization Fund
summary: Supports cleanup and redevelopment of contaminated industrial and waterfront sites.
notes: Highly relevant for waterfront industrial redevelopment.

title: Ohio Brownfield Remediation Program
summary: Provides funding for remediation and assessment of brownfield sites for redevelopment.
notes: Can support former industrial parcels near port operations.

title: Ohio EPA Water Pollution Control Loan Fund (WPCLF)
summary: Low-interest financing program for wastewater and stormwater infrastructure projects.
notes: Useful for stormwater and shoreline resilience improvements.

title: H2Ohio Grant Program
summary: Supports projects improving water quality and resilience in the Lake Erie watershed.
notes: Potential fit for sediment management and shoreline resilience.

title: Ohio Rail Development Commission Industrial Rail Access Program
summary: Funds rail infrastructure projects improving freight mobility and economic development.
notes: Relevant for port rail connectivity upgrades.

title: JobsOhio Vibrant Community Program
summary: Supports catalytic site and infrastructure development tied to economic growth.
notes: Requires coordination with regional economic development partners.

title: JobsOhio Site Inventory Program
summary: Supports due diligence and site readiness studies for industrial and logistics properties.
notes: Useful for expanding port industrial land inventory.

title: Ohio Coastal Management Program Grants
summary: Funds coastal erosion mitigation waterfront access and resilience planning projects.
notes: Strong alignment with shoreline stabilization efforts.

title: Lake Erie Protection Fund Grants
summary: Supports projects improving Lake Erie water quality and environmental sustainability.
notes: Could support dredging and sediment innovation initiatives.

title: Ohio EPA Diesel Emissions Reduction Grants
summary: Supports replacement and retrofits of diesel equipment and vehicles.
notes: Relevant for cargo handling equipment electrification.

title: Northeast Ohio Areawide Coordinating Agency Transportation for Livable Communities Initiative
summary: Planning grants for multimodal transportation and economic development initiatives.
notes: Could support waterfront mobility and access planning.

title: NOACA Surface Transportation Block Grant Program
summary: Allocates regional transportation funding for roadway freight and infrastructure improvements.
notes: Can support truck and freight access improvements near port terminals.

title: Cuyahoga County Brownfield Redevelopment Fund
summary: Local funding support for brownfield cleanup and redevelopment projects.
notes: Program details may vary annually.

title: Cleveland Climate Action Fund
summary: Supports decarbonization resilience and clean energy infrastructure projects.
notes: Potential fit for port electrification partnerships.

title: Cleveland-Cuyahoga County Port Authority Environmental Grants Initiative
summary: Small partnership grants tied to waterfront sustainability and community initiatives.
notes: Program structure may change year to year.

title: Ohio Department of Development Roadwork Development Program
summary: Funds public road improvements supporting economic development projects.
notes: Relevant for industrial access roads serving port facilities.

title: Appalachian Regional Commission POWER Initiative
summary: Supports economic diversification and workforce projects in eligible Appalachian counties.
notes: Cuyahoga County eligibility may depend on project partnerships.

title: Great Lakes Restoration Initiative Regional Grants
summary: Supports restoration resilience and environmental improvement projects in Great Lakes communities.
notes: Some opportunities administered through state/regional partners rather than federal portals.

title: Ohio Alternative Fuel Transportation Program
summary: Supports deployment of alternative fuel and electric vehicle infrastructure.
notes: Potential fit for drayage truck electrification.

title: Ohio Air Quality Development Authority Clean Air Resource Center Grants
summary: Provides financing and grants for clean air and energy efficiency projects.
notes: Could support terminal electrification and emissions reduction.

title: Northeast Ohio Public Energy Council (NOPEC) Energized Community Grants
summary: Funds energy efficiency sustainability and community infrastructure projects.
notes: Smaller scale but flexible funding source.

title: Ohio Historic Preservation Tax Credit Program
summary: Tax credit program supporting rehabilitation of historic structures.
notes: Could apply to adaptive reuse of historic waterfront assets.

title: Cleveland Foundation Climate Resilience and Infrastructure Grants
summary: Philanthropic funding for resilience sustainability and neighborhood infrastructure initiatives.
notes: Best pursued through public-private partnerships.

title: Team NEO Site Development Grant Assistance
summary: Regional economic development support for industrial site readiness and expansion.
notes: Can complement JobsOhio funding applications.

title: Ohio Sea Grant Coastal Resilience Grants
summary: Funds applied research and pilot projects focused on Lake Erie resilience and coastal management.
notes: Useful for pilot studies and shoreline innovation.

title: Cuyahoga County Infrastructure Bank
summary: Flexible infrastructure financing tool for transportation and utility projects.
notes: Structured as financing rather than pure grant funding.

title: Ohio Workforce Grant for Maritime and Logistics Training
agency: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services
summary: Supports workforce development and logistics training programs aligned with regional industry demand.
notes: Potential fit for maritime workforce pipeline initiatives.
